contract.authorization: User explicitly approved per-file atomic replacement, regular-file modes and stable symlink targets, safe refusal for unsupported destinations
contract.publication: One file at a time; not a multi-file transaction
contract.unsupported: Hard links, special files/modes, insufficient parent permissions or unpreservable owner/group; extended ACL/xattr semantics not qualified
contract.termination: Old or complete new file; random stale siblings are ignored. New-file link/unlink commit-window termination can leave a complete hard-linked final/temp pair; identified stale sibling needs explicit removal before overwrite

focused.limits: One serial pair, same runtime/flags/inputs. Diagnostics input is separately parsed in both arms (production shares graph.diagnostics); input loading outside timer but inside cumulative RSS. Before lacks fsync, after includes per-file fsync/publication. No forced GC. Cache/order/GC effects and differing initial heap remain; focused RSS savings are not a production/Core RSS claim. High-water captured through export return, before hashing/report generation.

whole.limits: One lightly instrumented phase run. No controlled whole-analysis baseline at Stage 6.3; Stage 6.2 single uninstrumented sample remains context. Shared in-process RSS cannot be partitioned into Core/compiler/native. Phase endpoints miss instantaneous values; cumulative getrusage high-water brackets peak interval. High-water captured through analysis/export return, before post-timing verification/report generation.

ownershipAndFreshness.limits: Raw graph/diagnostics compared completely without normalization. Complete selected SQL rows compared in primary-key order; only sc_runs.created_at excluded. Complete semantic report/manifest run clocks are not byte-compared across analyses.
